meta.name: Advanced PPT-to-video component registry
meta.purpose: Higher-variance video components used to recompose PPT pages into micro-course style scenes.
meta.selection_rule: Prefer these components when the source page is too plain, has unused whitespace, or needs teaching-style explanation instead of a direct PPT copy.

blackboard_derivation.name: Blackboard derivation
blackboard_derivation.visual_treatment: dark teaching board, chalk accent, formula focus, rounded note chips
blackboard_derivation.video_treatment: title first, then equation/rule blocks appear in teaching order

formula_walkthrough.name: Formula walkthrough
formula_walkthrough.visual_treatment: rounded step rail with a worked-example panel
formula_walkthrough.video_treatment: advance step by step with the example panel held on screen

checkpoint_ladder.name: Checkpoint ladder
checkpoint_ladder.visual_treatment: vertical ladder with rounded checkpoint blocks and status tokens

radial_concept_map.name: Radial concept map
radial_concept_map.visual_treatment: central rounded node with orbiting concept pills
radial_concept_map.video_treatment: center appears first, branches expand around it

magazine_spread.name: Magazine spread
magazine_spread.visual_treatment: asymmetric editorial grid with a large quote/claim area and side notes
magazine_spread.video_treatment: headline settles first, side notes follow

rounded_step_cards.name: Rounded step cards
content_shape: short title with several compact cards
rounded_step_cards.visual_treatment: large-radius cards, soft color tokens, no sharp dashboard feel
rounded_step_cards.video_treatment: cards appear in a staggered rhythm

misconception_compare.name: Misconception compare
content_shape: two opposing groups or two states
misconception_compare.visual_treatment: two rounded panels with correction bridge and emphasis chip
misconception_compare.video_treatment: wrong/old side first, corrected side second

application_storyboard.name: Application storyboard
application_storyboard.visual_treatment: storyboard frames with concise captions and a summary rail
application_storyboard.video_treatment: frames reveal like a short case story
